title: Chapter 1079
text:
The space contained an abundance of light energy. From the perspective of a Mage, this place was filled with extremely high density light elements.

Han Xiao brought Ames and landed on a shallow river. The soil was colorful sand, no different from a beach.

Ames squatted down, picked up a grain of sand, and observed this irregular solid curiously. She applied some force with her fingers and crushed it. This grain of sand cracked, turned into light dust, and slowly rose into the air.

Looking up, a vast sea of clouds covered the sky. They were all made of gaseous light dust, dreamy and illusory. From time to time, light dust would rise from various places and merge into the sea of clouds. When it accumulated to a certain extent, this sea of clouds would start raining, and the light dust would fall to the ground, forming new landforms. This cycle repeated.

"So beautiful." Ames clicked her tongue in admiration.

Han Xiao came to the river, picked up a handful of liquid light, and watched as the golden liquid flowed through his fingers. He could not help but mutter, "The light pollution here is very serious."

"… Do you have to ruin the atmosphere?" Ames was helpless.

"I'm just telling the truth."

Han Xiao curled his lips, summoned a few industrial collection equipment, and casually said, "This phenomenon is very strange and has a lot of research value.

"The phenomenon here is very strange and has a lot of research value. It's a good opportunity to collect some materials for experiments."

As he spoke, he anchored the coordinates of this secondary dimension and recorded it in the database so that it would be convenient for him to come here again. After thinking about it, he named this secondary dimension 'Country of Light'.

After settling all this, Han Xiao set up some spacetime stabilizing anchors to prevent the Holy Light Particle from escaping. He then patted the Mysterious Energy Host and said, "Ah Huo, force the Holy Light Particle out."

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could not wait any longer. After receiving the order, it immediately released streams of red energy into the ground, forming a huge spider web that quickly spread out.

When Han Xiao counted to two hundred and twenty-one, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy finally reacted and said with ill intentions,

With malicious intent, it said, "I've found it. It's indeed sleeping. Watch me wake it up!"

As soon as it said that, Han Xiao and Ames felt the ground under their feet suddenly shake.

At the next moment, the entire space began to tremble, and the earth and mountains shook.

Before the two of them could take a closer look, a huge fountain of light suddenly erupted from the ground in the distance. It shot straight into the sky and turned into a white-gold light cluster with a sense of holiness. At the core was a dazzling sphere like a star, as if there was another sun in the sky.At this time, inside this platinum light cluster, there were visible streams of red Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Like hot oil meeting cold water, the reaction was extremely intense.With the appearance of this ball of light, an exasperated and manic mental wave instantly swept out."Mosaniel!You ambushed me again while I was sleeping!I will definitely kill you today! ""Narussus, is my energy delicious? Do you miss it?" The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy chuckled, his tone filled with reminiscence.Hearing this, Han Xiao's mouth twitched.He felt like there was a lot of information in this sentence. It sounded like this wasn't the first time he had done this …Tsk, your Esper Circle is really messy.The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy turned to look at Han Xiao, smiled, and said, "This is the Holy Light Particle you guys were talking about. It's a bit grumpy when it wakes up. I'll leave the rest to you."Primal Esper Ability Entities were very ancient and had their own names. 'Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy' and 'Holy Light Particle' were just names the outside world gave them.The Holy Light Particle quickly moved over and only then did it notice the group. Seeing the Mysterious Energy Host's appearance, its anger turned to joy."Hmm?You've been made into a puppet again?Hahaha, karma, you deserve it! ""Don't be too smug, you'll be there soon." The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy sneered. Little guy, it's your turn next.The Holy Light Particle turned to look at Han Xiao and Ames and said with dissatisfaction, "Humph, you're still so despicable. You actually helped the enemy get my body and tried to drag me down … You two brats from the main universe, no matter how it bewitched you, I'm not interested in playing with you now. Scram back to the main universe and don't bother me."Han Xiao did not care. He flipped his hand and took out a canned containment device. He tilted his head and said, "Do you want to come in yourself, or do you want me to help you?"Hearing this, the Holy Light Particle's body glowed brightly and released a violent energy wave. Its aura was fully unleashed, causing the entire space to tremble slightly. Its tone was extremely confident and arrogant."I'm not a weakling like Mosanil. You want to catch me? Are you mentally prepared?"Thirty seconds later …"Ouch, ouch, ouch, stop hitting me. I admit defeat."The Holy Light Particle that was still arrogant earlier had shrunk countless times and was contained in the canned container. She did not expect that the Holy Light Particle would be defeated with just one slap from Han Xiao.Han Xiao was not surprised at all. Primal Esper Ability Entities could not do anything in front of a peak Beyond Grade A Super. He only wondered where the Holy Light Particle got its confidence from.Seeing his old friend in trouble, it was the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's turn to gloat. He moved next to the containment device and chuckled. "Welcome to accompany me. This way, I won't be lonely anymore.""Mosanil!I'll kill you sooner or later!
